response.sql: WITH telescope_obs AS (SELECT t.*, o.lunarstage FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), phase_stats AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(bandusagepct) as phase_avg, COUNT(bandusagepct) as phase_count FROM telescope_obs GROUP BY lunarstage), mean_of_avgs AS (SELECT AVG(phase_avg) as overall_mean FROM phase_stats), filtered_phases AS (SELECT ps.phase_avg, ps.phase_count, m.overall_mean FROM phase_stats ps CROSS JOIN mean_of_avgs m WHERE ps.phase_avg > m.overall_mean) SELECT AVG(phase_avg) as avg_bandwidth, SUM(phase_count) as total_count, AVG(phase_avg - overall_mean) as avg_excess FROM filtered_phases
